```python
import narwhals as nw

# Sample DataFrame
data = {
    "id": [1, 2, 3],
    "jan": [100, 200, 300],
    "feb": [110, 210, 310],
    "mar": [120, 220, 320]
}
df = nw.from_dict(data)

# Reshape from wide to long format
long_df = df.unpivot(
    index="id",
    on=["jan", "feb", "mar"],
    variable_name="month",
    value_name="sales"
)

print(long_df)
```
